offers_products.reason: Manufactures engineered wood products, plywood, lumber and wholesale distributes building materials like siding, decking, metal, roofing.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from goods manufactured and distributed; delivery and service support are incidental to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to dealers, home improvement centers, and industrial customers, not directly to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are building material dealers, home improvement centers, and industrial customers buying for resale or construction.

recurring_revenue.reason: Dealers repeatedly reorder lumber, panels and building products from the distribution business, the larger part of sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand tied to new home construction and remodeling, which fall sharply in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent, repeat orders of building materials by dealers; individual sales are small relative to buyers' spending.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is from manufactured wood products and distributed goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly dealers, home improvement centers and light commercial builders, many of them mid-sized or small.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates wood product mills plus more than 60 distribution and manufacturing facilities needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Wholesale distribution is the larger segment; manufacturing of engineered wood is the other.
